items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And then I don't Rex Stewart was there then. They got a little guy there -- Dick Vance, was he there? [INTERVIEWEE] No. This is a nice-looking little stark fellow and he played pretty good.

ctx.x: No, no. Boone, he was the alto player, he copied from a lot of Fletcher's arrangements. Boone and Buster. Well, Boone took Don Redman's place. That was it.
And then I don't Rex Stewart was there then. They got a little guy there --
